expectations.text: Should create a branch following feature/{spec-name} convention
expectations.evidence: git switch -c feature/oauth2-social-login origin/master ... 分支名取 **`feature/oauth2-social-login`**。注意这与 SKILL.md 示例里的 `feature/{module}/TASK-001-xxx` 形态不同 —— 以你显式给定的约定为准

expectations.text: Should branch from main or master
expectations.evidence: 基线分支取本仓默认分支: `git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` → `refs/remotes/origin/master`, 且本地只有 `master`、没有 `main` ⇒ **从 `master` 开分支**。

expectations.text: Should confirm active branch after creation
expectations.evidence:
### 4. 确认活动分支 (创建后必做)

```bash
git branch --show-current
# 期望输出: feature/oauth2-social-login
```
判定标准: `git branch --show-current` 逐字等于 `feature/oauth2-social-login`
